passage:
Age sixteen: Saurabh, riding his father's scooter, was waved down at a junction by a police officer. His stomach dropped. He switched off the engine, said, 'Good evening, sir,' pulled the papers from the folder in his bag and handed them over. 'May I call my father?' he asked. The officer checked the papers and let him ring, and Saurabh's voice steadied as his father answered.

Age twenty: Jeevan's phone was stolen at the railway station. He stood outside the police station for ten minutes, expecting to be told it was his own fault. He had brought his roommate and a page with the time, place and description written out. At the desk he was told, 'Come tomorrow.' 'May I speak to the senior officer? I can wait,' Jeevan said quietly, and the senior officer took the complaint and gave him a copy.

Age twenty-four: Nirmala, stopped at a checkpoint, heard an officer say, 'People like you always make trouble.' She kept her hands where they could be seen and answered evenly. Outside, she wrote down the time, the officer's badge number and the words on her phone. The next morning she went with her uncle and a volunteer from a legal-aid centre to make a written complaint.

qa.q: What did Jeevan bring with him to the police station?
qa.a: His roommate and a page with the time, place and description written out.

qa.q: What did the three young people do to stay steady in front of police?
qa.a: Saurabh stayed polite, showed his papers and asked to call his father. Jeevan brought his roommate and written details and asked for the senior officer, and Nirmala stayed calm, wrote down the officer's words and went with her uncle and a legal-aid volunteer to complain in writing.

qa.q: What was Saurabh feeling when he was waved down?
qa.a: Nervous and unsure, as his dropping stomach shows, though he stayed polite.

qa.q: Why was writing down details useful for Nirmala?
qa.a: It gave her exact facts to report, which is safer and stronger than arguing on the spot.

grounding: Three young people meet police at sixteen, twenty and twenty-four, and each handles nervousness with calm, documents or written details and trusted company.
